notes.title: Spooky Halloween Elevator!
notes.content:
[h2]🎃Happy Halloween!👻[/h2]
The mysterious elevator that's definitely not haunted has been decorated in a Halloween mood for tonight!

[h3]🌱Added Halloween Mode[/h3]
・Added numerous new endings. Witness these "outlandish" scenarios and conclusions filled with terror and surprises.
・Revamped gimmicks on each floor. Yumi embarks on a new adventure with completely different mechanics!
・Also added Halloween Mode-specific achievements.

[h3]🌱Steam Scream: The Revenge[/h3]
We're honored to be invited to Steam's Halloween Festival again this year! We have a sale going on for three horror games, including this one. If you haven't purchased yet, this is the perfect opportunity.

[No Ghost in Stay Home]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1645640/
*[Absolutely No Ghosts on Night Duty] also had a Halloween Mode update last year.

[The Travel Game]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2123800/

[h3]🌱About Game Streaming & Fan Creations[/h3]
As stated in the Readme, we fully permit game streaming and fan creations of Midoriko Games' works. It's also fine to enjoy them through your favorite streamer's videos! But, of course, we would be very happy if you buy and play the game yourself!

────────────────────

🌱If you notice anything, please don't hesitate to contact us via our official email address or X.

Email: midoriko.games@gmail.com
X: https://twitter.com/GamesMidoriko

Have a great Halloween!✨🎃👻✨

notes.title: Correction Update (Ver1.02.01) and The Important Notice
notes.content:
[h2]🌱About the Update[/h2]
I have added effects and graphics to some of the endings. Also, I've made improvements so that you can understand essential systems such as purchasing hints even if you overlook the tips.

[h2]🌱About the Halloween Update[/h2]

Last year, in line with Steam's Scream Fest (Halloween event), I conducted the ending addition and Halloween update for [No Ghost in Stay Home].
This year, I was busy and struggling with the new work, but I received voices that were looking forward to the update, so I also decided on [No Ghost in Sky Elevator].
I am thinking about adding about 10 endings. There are already more ideas than that, and the content, including the existence of the true ending, is almost solidified.

In the Halloween additional endings, [b]you might find out a significant fact about the protagonist, Yumi...[/b]

Please look forward to it! 🤗
That's all for now.

🌱If you notice anything else, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Please contact us at the official e-mail address, or X!

Email: midoriko.games@gmail.com

X: https://twitter.com/GamesMidoriko
